controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-18T09:10:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T10:10:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "dev-ws-1"
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
